Method of Attack: Supply chain attack injecting malicious code that injects a crypto wallet drainer into websites
Malicious script displays web3 prompts to connect cryptocurrency wallets and drains all assets and NFTs upon connection
Impacted Systems: Websites using Lottie Web Player script versions 2.0.5, 2.0.6, 2.0.7
Attack Vector: Compromised npm package uploaded using stolen developer authentication token
Third-party CDNs serving compromised versions without pinned versions
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious versions 2.0.5, 2.0.6, 2.0.7 of lottie-player npm package
